review_scope: Targeted bilingual review of ten headlines, all flagged entries, reproducible samples, volume arithmetic, currencies and tracking identifiers.

corrections.translation: 向 Superbuy 估算运费前，打包要求应该怎么写

corrections.translation: Superbuy 代购还是转运？按实际购买方式选择订单类型

corrections.source: Tracking Superbuy photo and packing requests from instruction to result
corrections.translation: 在 Superbuy 提交拍照和打包要求后，如何跟进处理结果

corrections.source: For a rectangular box, multiply length by width by height to compare volumes. If an illustrative first estimate uses 40 by 25 by 15 centimetres, the rectangular volume is 15,000 cubic centimetres. A measured outer package of 42 by 28 by 18 is 21,168 cubic centimetres. The difference is 6,168 cubic centimetres, around 41 percent more space than the estimate.
corrections.translation: 比较长方体纸箱的体积时，把长、宽、高相乘。假设最初估计为 40 × 25 × 15 厘米，体积就是 15,000 立方厘米。如果外包装实测为 42 × 28 × 18 厘米，体积便是 21,168 立方厘米，比预估多出 6,168 立方厘米，约多占 41% 的空间。

corrections.source: For an illustrative calculation, a packed parcel measuring 40 by 30 by 20 centimetres occupies 24,000 cubic centimetres. A second packing option measuring 40 by 30 by 15 occupies 18,000. That is a reduction of 6,000 cubic centimetres, or one quarter of the first volume. It does not follow that the shipping charge falls by one quarter. Check each eligible route's actual billing and size rules and whether the protective treatment still meets your needs.
corrections.translation: 例如，打包后的包裹长宽高为 40 × 30 × 20 厘米，体积是 24,000 立方厘米。换成 40 × 30 × 15 厘米的包装，体积为 18,000 立方厘米，减少了 6,000 立方厘米，也就是原体积的四分之一。运费并不一定随之降低四分之一。请分别核对可选路线的实际计费方式和尺寸限制，并确认调整后的包装仍能提供所需的保护。

corrections.source: Imagine a seller invoice of 150 in the seller's currency, plus 10 for domestic delivery. If you paid those amounts directly, your running purchase cost is 160. Entering 150 as an item value on a forwarding worksheet does not raise the running cost to 310. Add actual new charges when they occur, identifying the service and currency for each. These figures illustrate bookkeeping only; the applicable amounts come from your own order.
corrections.translation: 假设卖家用自己的结算货币开出金额为 150 的商品账单，另收 10 的国内运费。如果两笔都由你直接支付，此时累计采购成本是 160。在转运明细里填入 150 作为商品价值，不会让总成本变成 310。以后实际发生新费用时再计入，并逐笔注明服务和币种。这些数字仅用于说明如何记账，实际金额以自己的订单为准。

corrections.source: Superbuy's shipping calculator requests the destination, warehouse, weight, size and item category. Use the same inputs as the measured parcel when comparing the resulting options. Weights shown in kilograms may require conversion if the form asks for grams. One kilogram equals one thousand grams. Copying 2.4 into a grams field misstates the input by a factor of a thousand.
corrections.translation: Superbuy 的运费计算器需要填写目的地、仓库、重量、尺寸和商品类别。对比不同方案时，请统一使用同一包裹的实测数据。如果称重结果以千克计，而表单要求填克，就要先换算。1 千克等于 1,000 克。若包裹重 2.4 千克，直接在克数栏填 2.4，输入的重量就只有实际重量的千分之一。

corrections.source: Suppose the request asked for chest width on a closed jacket laid flat. The returned picture shows a tape around the outside of an open jacket on a hanger. It may be a legitimate measurement, but it does not answer your comparison with a garment measured flat. Explain the difference and ask whether the original view can be supplied under the selected service. Avoid assuming another charge is due or a refund is guaranteed until the actual terms and response are clear.
corrections.translation: 假设你要求把夹克扣好、平铺，再测量胸部横向宽度。收到的照片却是敞开的夹克挂在衣架上，软尺绕着外侧一圈。这个量法本身可以得到一个尺寸，但不能拿来和你平铺测量的衣服直接比较。说明两种量法的区别，询问所选服务能否按原要求补拍。是否需要另付费用或能否退款，要根据实际条款和客服答复判断。

corrections.source: If the arrangement is ambiguous, ask for an inventory check that someone can carry out. An example request is: “For the warehouse entry linked to the domestic waybill ending 482, please confirm whether it contains two lamp bases and whether any fittings packets were recorded with them.” Include the full reference in the private inquiry. Keep the question about contents separate from a second question about damaged finish or measurements. Each has a different piece of evidence that can settle it.
corrections.translation: 如果不清楚货物分装在哪一箱，请向仓库提出一项能实际核对的请求。例如：“请核查与尾号 482 的国内快递单关联的入库记录：箱内是否有两个灯座？是否同时登记了装有安装配件的小袋？”在私下提交的工单里附上完整单号。箱内物品、表面涂层受损以及尺寸是不同的问题，应分开询问，因为各自需要不同的证据。

corrections.source: Suppose a seller lists a box as 420 by 260 by 150 millimetres and the scale reads 1.80 kilograms. Its corresponding inputs are 42 by 26 by 15 centimetres and 1,800 grams. If one side is accidentally entered as 150 centimetres, the box in the calculator becomes ten times taller than the box on the desk. A disappearing route or implausibly high figure can be a reason to recheck units before assuming the carrier has changed its prices.
corrections.translation: 假设卖家标示的纸箱尺寸为 420 × 260 × 150 毫米，秤上显示 1.80 千克。如果输入栏使用厘米和克，就应填写 42 × 26 × 15 厘米、1,800 克。如果把高度从 15 厘米误填为 150 厘米，计算器就会把箱子当成实际高度的十倍。遇到某条线路不再显示或预估运费高得不合常理时，先核对单位，再判断承运商是否调价。

corrections.source: Suppose two purchases appear in your marketplace history with almost identical titles and consecutive order dates. On one, the waybill ends in 381; on the other, it ends in 318. A glance at the first digits may suggest that both refer to the delivery you just received. Compare the entire string. When you later write to support, paste the complete number rather than the last three digits used in your private notes.
corrections.translation: 假设购买记录中有两笔商品名称几乎相同、下单日期相邻的订单。一笔的运单号以 381 结尾，另一笔以 318 结尾。只看开头几位，可能误以为两笔都对应刚收到的包裹。请核对整串号码。给客服发消息时粘贴完整运单号，末尾三位只用作个人笔记中的简称。

corrections.source: I paid the seller directly. Which Superbuy service should I look at?
corrections.translation: 我已经直接付款给卖家，应该看 Superbuy 的哪项服务？

corrections.source: Read the parcel forwarding guide. It covers items you bought yourself and need received at a Superbuy warehouse. A shopping agent order instead asks Superbuy to make the purchase.
corrections.translation: 请查看转运指南。自行购买、需要 Superbuy 仓库代收的商品适用转运服务。如果需要 Superbuy 替你向卖家购买商品，则使用代购服务。

corrections.source: Should I register a forwarding request for an item Superbuy bought for me?
corrections.translation: Superbuy 已经代购的商品，还要另外提交转运申请吗？

corrections.source: Superbuy says that a purchase made through its shopping agent service does not require a separate forwarding submission. Check the shopping order and its warehouse status first.
corrections.translation: 根据 Superbuy 的说明，使用其代购服务购买的商品无需另行申请转运。先查看代购订单及该商品的入库状态。

corrections.source: Imagine a listing for sketchbooks with “black A5, dotted” and “black A5, blank.” The thumbnail can be identical because it shows the closed cover. If your requirement is blank paper, the word at the end is the decisive feature. Save the complete option text. A hand-written note saying “black notebook” loses precisely the detail that the warehouse may later need to verify.
corrections.translation: 假设素描本有“黑色 A5，点阵内页”和“黑色 A5，空白内页”两个选项。缩略图只拍了合上的封面，因此可能一模一样。如果你需要无格无点的纸，决定性信息是选项末尾的内页说明。保存卖家的完整选项名称。只记“黑色笔记本”，恰好会漏掉之后需要仓库核查的细节。

corrections.source: For example, a seller may send a notebook today and its separately ordered refill tomorrow. The seller order can be the same on both dispatch notices while the carrier numbers differ. To check whether both pieces arrived, match each waybill and then compare the contents of the warehouse entries. An account search for the ordinary-language title “notebook” alone may miss a refill entered under a different name.
corrections.translation: 例如，卖家今天发出纸质笔记本，明天再发单独订购的替芯纸。两份发货通知上的卖家订单号可能相同，承运商的运单号却不同。要确认两件是否都到了，请将每个运单号与相应的入库记录逐一匹配，再核对里面的物品。仅在账户里搜索“笔记本”，可能找不到用其他名称登记的替芯纸。

corrections.source: That comparison describes geometry only. Whether a particular carrier uses dimensional billing, how it converts volume into a billing weight, how it rounds and how much it charges are separate questions. Read the selected route rules instead of borrowing a divisor from a different carrier's tutorial. A 41 percent increase in volume does not prove that freight increased by 41 percent. The actual weight, route limits and rate bands may matter more.
corrections.translation: 这个比较只说明箱体容积的变化。承运商是否按体积重量计费、如何用容积换算计费重量、怎样取整、适用哪档费率，都要另查。请阅读所选线路的规则，不要照搬其他承运商示例中的除数。容积增加 41% 并不证明运费增加 41%。实际重量、线路尺寸限制和计费区间都可能更关键。

corrections.source: An order note works best when it identifies an option the agent can check. Instead of “as pictured,” write the original seller option followed by your explanation of what matters. For a sketchbook, that might be “black cover, A5, blank pages; please ask before replacing with dotted paper.” If the seller allows customization, reproduce spelling and case carefully and specify any uncertainties before payment.
corrections.translation: 订单备注应写出采购人员可以核对的选项。不要只写“如图”，请保留卖家的原始选项名称，再说明在意的条件。以素描本为例：“黑色封面，A5，空白内页。如需改成点阵纸，请先联系我。”如卖家支持定制，请核对拼写和大小写，并在付款前把不确定之处问清楚。

corrections.source: An availability decision and a packing decision are separate. You might know exactly where every unit is but still need to decide whether partial international delivery serves your purpose. For a modular lamp, shipping the bases without fittings can leave you with two unusable pieces at home. For several independent notebooks, an early partial shipment may be more practical. Describe the consequence of dispatching the available pieces before comparing prices.
corrections.translation: 确认哪些商品已到仓，和决定哪些商品适合现在发出，是两件事。即使知道每件在哪里，也要判断分批国际运输是否实用。组装灯若只寄回两个底座，却没有安装配件，两个底座到家都可能用不上。几本可以分别使用的纸质笔记本则不同，先寄其中几本也许更方便。比较运费前，先想清楚只寄现有物品会有什么结果。

corrections.source: Where should I get the address for my forwarding shipment?
corrections.translation: 通过 Superbuy 转运时，应该去哪里找收货地址？

corrections.source: Use the receiving address displayed in your own Superbuy forwarding account for the selected warehouse. Copy all the address parts and account-specific identification exactly before sending the seller the delivery instructions.
corrections.translation: 登录自己的 Superbuy 转运账户，查看所选仓库对应的收货地址。把各段地址和用于识别你账户的信息完整抄给卖家，再请对方发货。

corrections.source: Can I use the warehouse address from someone else's tutorial?
corrections.translation: 能照着别人的教程填写仓库地址吗？

corrections.source: A screenshot may show an old address or a different user's identifying information. Open your own account, select the applicable warehouse and compare the full address with the seller's order before dispatch.
corrections.translation: 截图可能显示旧地址，也可能带有别人的账户识别信息。发货前，登录自己的账户选好仓库，把显示的完整地址与卖家订单上的收货信息逐项核对。

corrections.source: What if my forwarding item has no marketplace product URL?
corrections.translation: 自购转运的物品没有商品链接，怎么填写？

corrections.source: Superbuy's forwarding guide describes supplying an item name and type for an already prepared parcel. Describe the actual contents and use the form's current requirements to check whether review is possible.
corrections.translation: Superbuy 转运指南说明，已备妥的包裹可以填写物品名称和类别。按实际内容描述，并查看当前表单要求，确认是否具备提交审核的条件。

corrections.source: What do I check before sending a self-purchased item to the warehouse?
corrections.translation: 让卖家把自购物品寄到仓库前，要确认什么？

corrections.source: Check the forwarding review result, the approved item, the selected warehouse and the receiving instructions. Resolve a restriction or incomplete request before asking your seller to dispatch.
corrections.translation: 检查转运审核结果、获准转运的物品、所选仓库和收货说明。有物品限制或申请信息不完整时，先处理清楚，再让卖家发货。

corrections.source: Is the seller's order number the domestic tracking number?
corrections.translation: 卖家的订单号就是中国境内快递单号吗？

corrections.source: The seller order identifies the purchase. The waybill identifies a physical shipment handled by a carrier. Copy the carrier name and waybill from the dispatch record when completing forwarding logistics.
corrections.translation: 订单号用于识别这笔买卖，快递单号对应承运商实际揽运的一票货。填写转运物流信息时，应从卖家的发货记录中抄录承运商名称和快递单号。

corrections.source: My seller split a purchase into two boxes. How should I record it?
corrections.translation: 一笔订单被卖家分成两箱寄出，该怎么记录？

corrections.source: Keep a separate row for each carrier and waybill. Ask which pieces went into each box, then compare each arrival with the warehouse record. One delivered box does not account for every unit purchased.
corrections.translation: 每箱单独记录承运商和快递单号，向卖家问清各箱装了哪些物品，再分别核对到仓记录。只有一箱显示签收，无法证明整笔订单已全部到仓。

corrections.source: Where do I see items that have been stocked at Superbuy?
corrections.translation: Superbuy 已入库的物品在哪里看？

corrections.source: The official forwarding and app guides direct customers to My Warehouse. Match the entry with your order or forwarding request. Use the domestic carrier's scan to investigate timing when the stock entry is missing.
corrections.translation: 官方转运和应用指南都指向 My Warehouse。找到对应条目后，与代购订单或转运申请核对。如果还没有入库条目，先查国内承运商的扫描时间和状态，了解货物进度。

corrections.source: Which photos help distinguish two otherwise identical garments?
corrections.translation: 两件外观几乎相同的衣服，哪些照片能分清？

corrections.source: Ask for an overview and a readable size or option label associated with each warehouse entry. Record the item reference beside the photograph before combining anything for delivery.
corrections.translation: 按各自的仓库编号，请仓库拍全貌和能读清的尺码或款式标签。把相应编号记在照片旁，再决定怎样合包发货。

corrections.source: Can a warehouse photo confirm that an electrical item works?
corrections.translation: 仓库照片能证明电器正常工作吗？

corrections.source: A picture may show the model and visible condition. Functional testing is a separate question. Ask which inspection is available for that item and whether the requested test can actually be performed.
corrections.translation: 照片能帮助核对型号和可见的外观，通电或功能测试则是另一项检查。先问清仓库对该物品提供哪些检查，以及你需要的测试能否实际完成。

corrections.source: Should I include an item with unresolved damage in a parcel?
corrections.translation: 物品有损坏还没处理，要先选进国际包裹吗？

corrections.source: Check its order and contact the relevant service first. Clearly identify the affected unit and ask what remedies remain while it is still at the warehouse. Keep it off the dispatch selection until you have made a decision.
corrections.translation: 先核对订单，联系对应服务渠道并指明具体物品。趁物品还在仓库，问清可采取哪些补救措施；决定如何处理前，先不要勾选发货。

corrections.source: How do I compare a shipping deposit with the final charge?
corrections.translation: 怎样核对预付运费和最后实际收取的运费？

corrections.source: Record the route, destination, contents, estimated weight and deposit at submission. Compare them with the packed dimensions, verified weight and charge in the parcel record. Check current route terms for the treatment of differences.
corrections.translation: 提交包裹时记录线路、目的地、内容物、预估重量和预付金额，再与包裹记录中的实测外箱尺寸、核定重量和运费比较。差额怎样处理，要看该线路当前的条款。

corrections.source: Do dimensions from the seller's product page describe my outbound parcel?
corrections.translation: 卖家商品页标的尺寸，就是国际包裹的尺寸吗？

corrections.source: They may describe the item or its retail box. International estimates may depend on the outer packed parcel. Record what was measured, including its units and packaging state.
corrections.translation: 页面数字可能是商品本身或零售包装的尺寸。国际运费估算可能需要装箱后的包裹外尺寸。记录测量对象、单位，以及当时是否已经包装。

corrections.source: Which packing instructions should I give for fragile parts?
corrections.translation: 对易碎部件该怎样写包装要求？

corrections.source: Describe which surfaces need separation, what must stay together, and which protective pieces should be retained. Ask whether the requested packing is available and review any charge before authorizing it.
corrections.translation: 写明哪些表面需要隔开，哪些部件应放在一起，哪些保护垫或固定件要保留。先确认仓库能否按要求包装，再核对费用并决定是否授权。

corrections.source: Why might my selected shipping line change after consolidation?
corrections.translation: 为什么合包后原来选的线路可能会变？

corrections.source: The packed parcel can differ in dimensions, weight or contents from the original estimate. Check the live list of routes available for the complete parcel and its destination.
corrections.translation: 合包后的外尺寸、重量或内容物可能与最初估算不同。以完整包裹和实际目的地为准，重新查看当时可用的线路。

corrections.source: Where can I follow a parcel after Superbuy dispatches it?
corrections.translation: Superbuy 发出国际包裹后，在哪里跟踪？

corrections.source: The app guide directs buyers to My Parcel in the user center. Use the outbound tracking reference on that parcel, keeping earlier seller tracking numbers with their respective domestic shipments.
corrections.translation: 应用指南指向个人中心的 My Parcel。用该包裹的出库追踪号查询；卖家先前提供的快递单号仍分别保留在对应的国内运输记录中。

corrections.source: What should I send support about a delivered parcel missing from My Warehouse?
corrections.translation: 快递显示已签收，但 My Warehouse 没有记录，向客服提供什么？

corrections.source: Include the forwarding reference, warehouse selected, carrier, waybill, delivery scan and expected contents. Explain the specific mismatch and provide the unredacted private details only through the official support channel.
corrections.translation: 提供转运申请编号、所选仓库、承运商、快递单号、签收扫描记录和预期物品清单。说明具体哪一项对不上；完整的个人信息只通过官方客服渠道提交。

corrections.source: How can I check whether a shipping request applies to one item or the whole parcel?
corrections.translation: 怎样判断一项服务是针对单件商品，还是整个包裹？

corrections.source: Read the service name and quantity on the order. For example, a close photo of one item and reinforcement of the outer carton concern different objects. Ask for clarification before paying for an ambiguous request.
corrections.translation: 看订单上的服务名称和数量。例如，给单件商品拍细节图与加固外箱，针对的是两个不同对象。说明含糊时，付款前先向客服问清。

corrections.source: Which record should I use for an international delivery issue?
corrections.translation: 国际投递出问题时，先查哪份记录？

corrections.source: Begin with the outbound parcel reference and current tracking event. If a particular item is affected, add its warehouse entry. Keep the package, label and relevant photos available for the investigation.
corrections.translation: 先查出库包裹编号和最新物流事件。问题涉及某件商品时，再补上它的仓库记录。保留包装、面单和相关照片，方便核实。

corrections.source: Can I use a friend's shipping estimate for my own budget?
corrections.translation: 能用朋友的运费估算做自己的预算吗？

corrections.source: Only as a rough comparison. Match the destination, date, route, parcel dimensions, weight and service options. Your own live quote is the relevant estimate for your shipment.
corrections.translation: 可以作粗略参考，但要对齐目的地、日期、线路、包裹外尺寸、重量和服务选项。真正适用于你这票货的是你自己当前查询到的报价。

corrections.source: Collect three measurements, their units and their object
corrections.translation: 记录长宽高、单位和测量对象

corrections.source: Normalize units before comparing anything
corrections.translation: 先统一单位，再比较尺寸

corrections.source: Close the request with its evidence

corrections.source: Record length, width and height together. A single “size” such as 40 centimetres cannot tell you whether a box is long and narrow or nearly square. Identify the object measured: loose product, retail box, seller delivery carton or packed outbound parcel. A measurement is useful only when you know which of these four things it describes.
corrections.translation: 长、宽、高要一起记。只有“40 厘米”一个数字，看不出箱子是狭长还是接近方形。还要注明测的是裸商品、零售包装、卖家发货用的纸箱，还是已经装好的出库包裹。说清是哪一种，这组尺寸才有比较意义。

corrections.source: Consider an item weighing 1,800 grams in its seller packaging. Its final packed weight becomes 2,100 grams. If you change the box size, weight and destination at the same time, the resulting difference cannot tell you which factor mattered. A pair of controlled estimates identifies whether one change appears sufficient to alter the quote. The calculator remains an estimate; the exercise is designed to clarify assumptions rather than reproduce a carrier invoice exactly.
corrections.translation: 例如，商品含卖家包装称重 1,800 克，最终装好后是 2,100 克。如果同时改动箱子尺寸、重量和目的地，两次报价的差额就不能归因于其中某一项。保留其他条件，只改一个输入做两次估算，才能判断单项变化是否足以改变报价。计算器给出的是估算结果；这项对照用来澄清假设，无法精确还原承运商账单。

corrections.source: If the account and your worksheet still disagree, include the original units in your inquiry. A support agent can check a photo of the scale and measuring tape more readily than a number stripped of its unit and packing context.
corrections.translation: 如果账户里的记录与自己的表格还是对不上，询问时附上原始单位。比起一个脱离单位和包装状态的数字，客服更容易通过同时显示秤读数和卷尺的照片核实。

corrections.source: Imagine buying a desk organiser and a pen tray from one seller. The retailer issues two domestic waybills. The organiser shows a delivery scan, while the tray is still moving. You see one warehouse entry described as a desk accessory. Before reporting a missing piece, compare the first tracking number with the warehouse reference and inspect the photo. If it depicts the organiser, the current records are consistent: one item is stocked and the other is still in transit.
corrections.translation: 假设你向同一卖家买了桌面收纳架和笔盘，卖家给了两个国内运单号。收纳架显示已签收，笔盘还在运输中，而仓库只有一条“桌面用品”记录。先把第一个运单号和仓库编号核对，再看照片。照片拍的是收纳架，两边的记录就吻合：一件已入库，另一件仍在路上。此时不必先认定少件。

corrections.source: Now change one detail. The merchant says both items were in the first carton and the second number was a cancelled replacement label. The warehouse picture still shows only the organiser. The open question has changed. It now concerns the contents of a delivered carton and the status of a second unused label. Ask the merchant to confirm its packing list. Ask Superbuy which items were recorded under the first waybill. Keep the distinction clear and avoid asking a carrier to locate an item that may never have travelled under its number.
corrections.translation: 换个条件：卖家说两件都放在第一箱，第二个号码只是已取消的备用面单，但仓库照片里仍然只有收纳架。现在要查的是已签收那一箱的实际内容，以及另一张面单是否确实作废。请卖家确认装箱清单，向 Superbuy 询问第一张运单下登记了哪些物品。不要请承运商按一个可能从未使用的号码查找笔盘。

corrections.source: For a single parcel, list the useful physical identifiers: type of item, selected option, quantity, seller name and any packing information provided. For a split delivery, provide a waybill-to-contents map. Avoid assuming that everything on one seller order was packed together. The merchant can often confirm which pieces accompanied a particular label.
corrections.translation: 单箱货列出能认出实物的信息：物品类别、所选规格、数量、卖家名称，以及卖家提供的包装说明。分箱寄送时，再加一张“运单号—箱内物品”的对应表。一笔卖家订单不等于同箱发货；卖家通常能确认某张面单下装了哪些物件。

corrections.source: Imagine two cartons listed as a bookcase frame and a shelf pack. The frame appears in My Warehouse, but the shelf pack does not. The support inquiry should name the unmatched shelf pack, its own waybill and its expected pieces. Sending only the original order title “bookcase” could lead to a reply identifying the already matched frame. Including the known warehouse entry is useful because it shows exactly which part of the purchase has been accounted for.
corrections.translation: 例如，书架分两箱，一箱是框架，另一箱是层板。My Warehouse 已显示框架，却没有层板。问客服时写明未匹配的是层板那一箱，提供该箱自己的运单号和应有的部件。只写原订单名称“书架”，对方可能只找到已经核对过的框架。把已匹配的仓库条目一并列出，方便对方看懂哪部分已经确认。

corrections.source: Imagine four entries. The first is a navy shirt whose size label and measurements you have accepted. The second is another navy shirt, this time in the larger size ordered for someone else. Its label is unreadable. The third is a mug with a fragile handle. The fourth is a book that you want to keep in its original slipcase. Four stocked entries do not automatically make four dispatch-ready entries.
corrections.translation: 假设仓库有四条记录。第一件是深蓝衬衫，标签和实测尺寸已验收；第二件是替别人买的大一码深蓝衬衫，标签看不清；第三件是杯柄易碎的马克杯；第四件是一本要保留原配书函的书。四件都已入库，不代表四件都已具备发货条件。

corrections.source: Mark the first shirt ready. Hold the second for identification. For the mug, record its current condition and the packing protection you require before it travels. Mark the book ready subject to retaining the slipcase. This leaves you with one item to inspect and two item-specific packing instructions. Those outcomes are much more informative than a list in which everything says “arrived.”
corrections.translation: 把第一件衬衫标为可发，第二件暂缓，等待确认身份。马克杯注明当前状况和出库前需要的保护；书可以发，但必须保留书函。这样清单上有一项待确认、两条针对具体物品的包装要求，比四行都写“已到”更能指导实际操作。

corrections.source: Check the live shipping options appropriate to the contents and destination before assuming everything should travel together. An item with a battery, a fragile shape or unusual dimensions may change the usable route list. Identify those properties from the actual item information. A vague catalogue category such as accessories rarely provides enough detail to settle shipping eligibility.
corrections.translation: 决定是否一箱发出之前，按实际内容物和目的地查询当前可用线路。含电池的商品、容易破损的造型或异常尺寸，都可能改变线路选择。根据具体商品信息核实这些特征；目录里笼统的“配件”分类通常不足以判断能否承运。

corrections.source: For the mug and book example, “remove all packaging” conflicts with retaining the book's slipcase and may remove protection from the mug. A more useful instruction identifies the outer delivery materials that can be removed, the retail pieces that must remain and the fragile surface requiring protection. Ask whether the requested treatment is available. Save the accepted instruction alongside the eventual packed parcel record.
corrections.translation: 回到杯子和书的例子，“拆除所有包装”与保留书函相冲突，也可能让杯子失去保护。更清楚的指令要分别指出可拆的卖家运输外包装、必须保留的零售包装，以及需要保护的易碎部位。先问仓库能否这样操作，把获确认的要求与最终包裹记录保存在一起。

corrections.source: Imagine a lamp body and shade purchased together. The seller packs the metal base in a small carton and the fragile shade in a larger one. The carrier delivers the base on Monday and the shade on Wednesday. You can reconcile that outcome if your notes identify each box and its expected contents. A single row stating “lamp delivered Monday” makes Wednesday's box look unexpected and Monday's receipt look complete. This example illustrates record keeping; check which information the current forwarding form needs for each waybill.
corrections.translation: 假设买的是一套灯，卖家把金属灯座放进小箱，把易碎灯罩装进大箱。承运商星期一送到灯座，星期三送到灯罩。按箱记录预期内容，就能解释两次到货；只记“星期一灯已到”，会让人以为第一箱已经齐货，第二箱反成了多出来的包裹。这个例子说明怎样记账，实际登记时仍要按当前转运表单填写每张运单所需的信息。

corrections.source: Explain why an unusual piece matters. A kraft sleeve may look disposable to someone packing hundreds of ordinary goods but belong to the presentation of a gift. A cheap foam insert can hold a fragile component away from a hard edge. The purpose lets the packer propose a suitable substitute where your written instruction cannot be followed exactly. Ask for the available option and price before committing to material changes.
corrections.translation: 不常见的包装要解释用途。每天处理大量货物的打包员可能会把牛皮纸外套当成废包装，但它也许是礼品展示的一部分。便宜的泡棉托也可能是用来隔开易碎部件和硬边的。说明用途后，如果原要求做不到，打包员更容易提出替代方案。更换材料前，先问清可选做法和价格。

corrections.source: Keep packing measurements separate from the product specifications. A seller might describe a poster as 30 by 40 centimetres, while the packed tube is longer than either edge because it includes end protection. A box may have one height printed on its side and a different actual height after its flaps have been adjusted. For a route comparison, ask for the dimensions that describe the final sealed configuration.
corrections.translation: 包裹尺寸与商品规格要分开记。卖家说海报是 30 × 40 厘米，装上海报筒和两端保护后，筒长可能比海报任一边都长。纸箱侧面印的高度，也可能与调整箱盖后实际封箱的高度不同。比较线路时，索取的是最终封好包裹的外尺寸。

corrections.source: For a measurement, define both endpoints and the unit. A request for the “length” of a coat might mean centre-back length, shoulder-to-hem length or sleeve length. Name which one you intend. Use the same method on a coat you own if fit is the decision. A number written in a message can be useful, but a photographed tape with both ends visible may answer additional questions about positioning.
corrections.translation: 要求测量时，写清起点、终点和单位。大衣的“长度”可能指后中长、肩至下摆的距离，也可能指袖长，应明确需要哪一种。如果要判断是否合身，在自有大衣上也使用同一种量法。消息里的数字有参考价值，但能看到卷尺两端的照片还能确认测量位置。

corrections.source: This record becomes especially valuable after delivery. If the gift sleeve is missing, you can show which unit required it and what instruction was accepted. If a packing treatment worked well, you can describe the successful arrangement in a future request rather than relying on an ambiguous service name. Optional services are easiest to manage when every instruction has an identifiable object and every completed request has a result you can actually inspect.
corrections.translation: 收到货后，这份记录尤其有用。礼品外套不见了，可以指出是哪件物品要求保留、仓库当时接受了什么指令。打包效果好时，下次可以直接描述有效的做法，不用只报一个含义模糊的服务名。每项要求都有明确的对象，每个完成的项目都有看得见的结果，可选服务就容易追踪。

corrections.source: An estimate based on a seller's product dimensions and a quote based on a closed outbound carton can produce different results even when nothing has gone wrong. The first figure may describe a bare item. The second includes everything that occupies space in transit. Before comparing a Superbuy shipping estimate with a parcel record, identify what each number measures and bring both scenarios onto the same basis.
corrections.translation: 卖家给的是商品尺寸，仓库填的是封箱后的包裹尺寸。即便两边的数据都准确，算出来的运费也可能不同：前者可能只测裸商品，后者包括运输途中实际占用空间的所有东西。用 Superbuy 的运费估算和包裹记录对账前，先弄清数字分别测的是什么，再把两组条件放到同一个基准下比较。

corrections.source: Take a pair of shoes as an example. The foot length on a size chart is a fit measurement. The outsole length describes a shoe. The shoebox dimensions describe a retail package. The external shipping carton may contain the shoebox plus padding and another item. Entering the foot length as the longest side of the parcel because it is the only visible number creates a precise-looking estimate from an unrelated measurement.
corrections.translation: 以一双鞋为例，尺码表上的脚长用来判断是否合脚，鞋底长度描述鞋本身，鞋盒长宽高描述零售包装。最终的运输外箱除了鞋盒，也可能装有填充物和另一件商品。如果页面只有脚长可查，就把它当作包裹的最长边，结果虽然能精确算出来，输入的却是完全不同的尺寸。

corrections.source: Superbuy's shipping calculator displays weight in grams and dimensions in centimetres. Read the labels on the version you are actually using. Convert a weight given in kilograms by multiplying by one thousand. Convert millimetres to centimetres by dividing by ten. Keep the original numbers in your notes as well as the converted values; this makes it easier to identify a transcription error later.
corrections.translation: Superbuy 运费计算器用克填写重量、用厘米填写尺寸，请以你打开的版本上显示的单位为准。千克换成克要乘以 1,000；毫米换成厘米要除以 10。把原数值和换算结果都记下来，如果后来发现数字不对，能追查是单位换错了，还是抄写时出了错。

corrections.source: Record the destination, warehouse, category and planned contents alongside the estimated weight and dimensions. These fields can affect which results are displayed. Two estimates with identical dimensions but different destinations are not a controlled test of packaging. Likewise, a different item category may change eligibility even if the physical package stays the same.
corrections.translation: 记录估计重量和尺寸时，把目的地、仓库、物品类别和准备寄送的内容也列出来。这些条件会影响可选的报价。两个包裹就算外尺寸完全一样，只要目的地不同，就不能靠报价差判断哪种包装更便宜。同样，实物没变而分类改变，也可能影响能选哪些线路。

corrections.source: Write a short scenario summary such as “one pair, original shoebox kept, outer carton dimensions unknown, using seller box dimensions as a lower-information estimate.” This tells you exactly what you will need to replace when the warehouse provides measurements. Avoid describing the provisional result as your confirmed freight. You may have an accurate seller measurement while still missing the relevant shipping measurement.
corrections.translation: 可以先写一句场景说明：“一双鞋，保留原鞋盒，运输外箱尺寸未知，暂以卖家鞋盒尺寸粗估。”仓库给出实测值后，你就知道该替换哪一项。这个阶段得到的是暂估运费。卖家提供的尺寸即使准确，也未必是计运费需要的尺寸。

corrections.source: Use the maximum outside dimensions of the packed item or carton as instructed by the carrier. Corner protectors, end caps and bulging sides can extend past an otherwise tidy rectangle. Ask which dimensions were returned by the warehouse if the values appear to describe only the item inside. Record measurements in a consistent order and label the longest side explicitly when route limits make it important.
corrections.translation: 按承运商的要求，量包装完成后最外侧之间的距离。护角、封头和鼓出的箱壁都可能超出规整的长方形。如果仓库给出的数字看起来像是商品内件，先问清它测的是什么。填写长宽高时固定顺序；线路有单边限制时，把最长边单独标出来。

corrections.source: A rolled print is a useful illustration. The artwork size is a flat rectangle. Its tube has a length and diameter. If several tubes are bundled in a rectangular carton, the outbound dimensions are different again. Comparing the flat sheet's height with the bundle's longest side tells you very little. Write down which packing state each entry represents before deciding that one of the measurements must be wrong.
corrections.translation: 一张卷起运输的画可以说明区别：平铺时是长方形，装进画筒后要看筒长和直径，几个画筒再装入长方形运输箱，外尺寸又变了。把画纸的高度直接与整箱最长边相比，看不出测量是否有错。先给每组数据标上包装状态，再核对。

corrections.source: To investigate a quote difference, start from the closest reproducible version of the first estimate. Substitute the packed dimensions while keeping destination, warehouse, item category, weight and route selection constant if possible. Record the new result. Then substitute the packed weight and compare again. If an input makes the original route unavailable, note that as an eligibility change rather than comparing two different services as though they were the same line.
corrections.translation: 排查报价差异时，先尽可能还原第一次估算的条件。保持目的地、仓库、物品类别、重量和线路不变，先只换成打包后的尺寸，保存结果；再换成实测重量，重新比较。如果修改某项数据后原线路不再可选，应记录为线路适用条件发生了变化，别把两种不同的服务当成同一条线比较。

corrections.source: Superbuy's guidance distinguishes the international shipping deposit from final shipping based on verified measurements and the selected service. When looking at a total, separate the freight component from selected packing, other services and any distinct adjustments displayed in the account. Preserve the original currency and keep the actual parcel reference with every amount.
corrections.translation: Superbuy 的说明区分提交时预付的国际运费，以及按最终核实尺寸和所选服务核算的实际运费。查看账户总额时，将运输费用、选购的包装、其他服务及单列的调整分别记账。保留交易的原币种，每笔金额都对应同一个实际包裹编号。

corrections.source: If your card statement is in a different currency, first compare the two Superbuy records in their common transaction currency. Only then investigate any payment conversion. Otherwise a difference in exchange rates can look like a change in packed weight. A useful support question specifies the original estimate, packed measurements, route, deposit and the single unmatched amount. “My shipping changed” leaves too many possible explanations unresolved.
corrections.translation: 如果银行卡账单使用另一种货币，先用两条 Superbuy 记录共有的交易币种核对，再检查付款环节的汇率。否则汇率差很容易被误认为包装重量变动。询问客服时，列出原估算、实包尺寸、线路、预付金额和唯一尚未对上的差额，比只说“我的运费变了”更容易得到明确答复。

corrections.source: Save the accepted packed dimensions, contents, packing treatment and weight after dispatch. This becomes a reference case for a similar future decision, provided you retain its conditions. Two identical retail items may still yield different outer cartons when one is shipped alone and the other is combined with a book or wrapped with additional protection.
corrections.translation: 发货后保存实际采用的包装方式、外尺寸、总重和内容物。有这些条件，这次的结果才可给下次类似购买作参考。同样一件零售商品，单独发、与一本书合寄，或者额外加保护材料，都可能需要不同大小的运输箱。

corrections.source: Review what your first estimate got right and what changed. Perhaps the scale weight was close but the protective carton was larger. Next time you know which missing measurement deserves attention before you choose a route. The goal is not to predict a shipping price from memory. It is to recognize which assumptions are provisional, replace them with the measured values and understand the resulting choice before committing the parcel to international delivery.
corrections.translation: 回看初次估计中哪些数接近实测，哪些发生了变化。例如，重量估得准，但保护用的外箱更大。下一次选线路前，就知道应该优先补哪项测量。目的不是背下一口价，而是识别暂时的假设，拿到实测值后及时替换，再决定是否提交国际配送。

corrections.source: For a two-box comparison, calculate each rectangular volume separately before adding them. Multiplying the sum of the lengths by the sum of the widths and heights produces an imaginary oversized box. Only use the measured dimensions of a single combined carton if the warehouse has actually combined the goods that way. Keep each individual carton measurement beside its corresponding quote.
corrections.translation: 比较两个箱子时，分别计算每个长方体的体积，再将两个体积相加。把两箱的长各自相加、宽相加、高相加再相乘，算出来的是一只并不存在的超大箱。只有仓库确实按某种方式合装成一个外箱，才用该外箱的实测尺寸。留下单箱数据，方便核对前后的组合。

corrections.source: A delivery notification from a seller can be accurate while your Superbuy warehouse list still looks incomplete. The two records are answering different questions. One reports what a carrier did with a parcel. The other records what was received, identified and stocked for your account. Before deciding which party to contact, follow the particular box across that boundary.
corrections.translation: 卖家的发货通知可以是准确的，Superbuy 的仓库清单也仍可能不完整。这两条记录对应不同环节。先把卖家发的那一票国内快递与正确的入库条目对上，再判断是否真的少了货，或者只是还没有出现能识别的仓库记录。

corrections.source: Start with the journey inside the country where the seller dispatches the goods. Your marketplace order links a buyer and a merchant. The merchant hands a box to a domestic carrier, which transports it to a receiving address. The receiving warehouse then identifies, inspects and records the goods. International shipment is a later choice. A tracking update mentioning delivery on the domestic leg cannot establish that an overseas parcel is on its way.
corrections.translation: 国内这一段是卖家把货交给承运商，再送到指定收货地址。平台订单记录的是买家与卖家的交易。仓库签收后，还要识别、检查和登记物品；是否发国际包裹是以后的选择。国内运单显示已送达，不能据此判断海外包裹已经启运。

corrections.source: For an agent purchase, find the Superbuy shopping order associated with the original item. For a purchase you made yourself, find the forwarding request and the logistics information you supplied. Superbuy's forwarding guide directs the user to provide the inbound shipping details after the item is reviewed. Check which of those two starting points describes your case. A shopping order number from a similar purchase can lead you to inspect the wrong record.
corrections.translation: 通过代购买的，先找与原商品对应的 Superbuy 代购订单；自己向卖家付款的，先找转运申请和自己填写的物流信息。Superbuy 转运指南要求在物品审核后补充进仓物流。先确认自己走的是哪条流程：误用另一笔相似商品的代购单号，只会查到错误的记录。

corrections.source: Open the seller's dispatch detail and identify the carrier and waybill together. Copy the full waybill as text, preserving any leading zeroes. Save the most recent event, its date and its stated location. A screenshot cropped down to the word “delivered” omits the information needed to connect the event to a particular carton. If a platform shows a tracking alias, keep the original carrier number where available.
corrections.translation: 打开卖家的发货详情，把承运商名称和完整快递单号一起抄录，开头的零也要保留。保存最新物流事件、日期和地点，只截“已送达”三个字，后面很难判断对应哪个箱子。如果平台还显示一个内部追踪别名，有条件时也留下承运商原始单号。

corrections.source: Read the wording of the event as well as the status colour. Label created, collected, out for delivery, delivered and returned to sender indicate different stages. A label can exist before the merchant hands over the box. An out-for-delivery update describes work in progress. A delivery event names an endpoint for the carrier's movement; it does not list the contents counted by warehouse staff.
corrections.translation: 既看状态颜色，也读事件原文。已生成面单、已揽件、派送中、已送达和退回寄件人，对应的阶段不一样。面单可以先于实际交货生成，“派送中”表示配送仍在进行。“已送达”能说明承运商的运输环节到哪一步，但不能证明仓库清点到了哪些物品。

corrections.source: Look at the destination alongside the event. Does the city and receiving address correspond to the warehouse selected on your request? An account login or internal recipient identifier can help connect the parcel with the customer after delivery. If the marketplace receipt shows a different address from the one in Superbuy, keep both records and explain the difference. Do not “correct” the screenshot before sharing it with official support: the original discrepancy may be exactly what identifies the problem.
corrections.translation: 查看扫描事件旁边的目的地。城市和收件地址是否与申请中所选仓库一致？账户或内部收件识别码能帮助仓库把到货与客户匹配。如果卖家订单的地址与 Superbuy 显示的地址不同，两份记录都留下并说明差异。发给官方客服前，不要把截图上的“错误”改掉；原始差异可能正是查明原因的线索。

corrections.source: Open My Warehouse for the relevant account. Superbuy's official guidance identifies this as the place to view stocked items. Review the warehouse entries around the delivery event. Check the item description, purchase or forwarding reference, quantity and available pictures. A translated title may differ substantially from the seller's original wording; use identifiers wherever possible.
corrections.translation: 登录对应账户的 My Warehouse。Superbuy 官方指南说明，已入库商品可在这里查看。找签收日期附近的条目，逐项核对品名、代购或转运编号、数量和照片。翻译过的品名与卖家标题可能差别很大，能用编号时优先用编号。

corrections.source: An inbound carrier parcel and a warehouse inventory entry need not have the same shape in your notes. One carton might hold several items. One seller purchase might produce two cartons. If the warehouse lists separate goods while your evidence describes a single carrier box, group those entries under the waybill rather than deleting one as a duplicate. Conversely, two received cartons cannot be reconciled solely from one product title without determining what each contained.
corrections.translation: 一票国内快递和一个库存条目，不一定一一对应。一个箱子可以装好几件，一次购买也可以分成两箱。如果仓库把同箱物品分别登记，就把几个条目归在同一个快递单号下，别当重复记录删掉。反过来，收到了两箱，也不能光凭一个商品标题认定全部匹配，仍要弄清每箱内容。

corrections.source: If the carrier shows only creation of a label, the merchant can usually clarify whether it actually dispatched that carton. If the event names the wrong destination, ask the sender and carrier about the address they used. If the correct parcel shows delivery to the intended warehouse but you cannot match it with an entry, Superbuy can investigate its receiving records. Explain which of these checks you have already completed.
corrections.translation: 如果承运商只显示“面单已创建”，向卖家确认是否真的交寄。如果扫描显示目的地不对，问寄件人和承运商实际使用的地址。如果正确的包裹显示已交到指定仓库，却找不到相应条目，可以请 Superbuy 查收货记录。说明自己已经完成哪些检查，避免双方反复查同一件事。

corrections.source: Use a concise opening sentence: “I am trying to match a domestic delivery to my forwarding record.” Follow with the forwarding or purchase reference, carrier, complete waybill, date and location of the delivery event, and expected product and quantity. State exactly what My Warehouse currently shows. A reply that confirms receipt of the box may still leave a separate question about contents; acknowledge the first point before asking about the second.
corrections.translation: 开头可以写：“我在核对一票国内快递和自己的转运申请。”接着列出转运或代购编号、承运商、完整单号、签收日期及地点、预期品名和数量，再说明 My Warehouse 目前显示什么。若对方只确认收到外箱，还要另查箱内物品；先记下已确认事项，再追问未确认部分。

corrections.source: It is tempting to enter the parcel again with a slightly different product title, especially if searching your account yields no result. First ask whether the existing forwarding or shopping record can be updated. Duplicate submissions can make it harder to tell which record describes the actual box. A new title cannot change which address is on the label or which carrier made the delivery.
corrections.translation: 搜不到时，不要急着换个商品名称再提交一次。先问现有的转运或代购记录能不能补充。重复登记反而可能让人分不清哪一条对应实物；改标题也不会改变面单上的地址或实际派送的承运商。

corrections.source: Keep a short activity note with dates and references rather than sending disconnected messages. If support requests a clearer proof of delivery, append it to the same inquiry when possible. If the seller supplies a corrected waybill, label the old one as superseded. This preserves what was known at the time of the first search while directing the next search to the better evidence.
corrections.translation: 用一份简短日志保存日期、编号和处理进度，少发彼此脱节的消息。客服要求更清楚的签收凭据时，尽可能补在同一条问询里。卖家提供更正后的运单号，就把旧号标为已替换。这样既保留了首次查询时掌握的信息，也能让下一次查询使用更可靠的凭据。

corrections.source: Mark a domestic shipment as matched when you can connect the carrier record, the correct purchase or forwarding request and the relevant warehouse entry or entries. Mark the contents separately if one piece remains unidentified. That division keeps the status accurate: “carton received, tray unconfirmed” tells you much more than simply “delivered.”
corrections.translation: 当承运商记录、正确的代购或转运申请以及相关仓库条目都能关联起来，才把这票国内运输标记为已匹配。如果还有一个部件无法识别，内容核验单列为待办。“已收箱，笔盘待确认”比只写“已送达”准确得多。

corrections.source: Later, if you submit the stocked items for international delivery, save the outbound parcel number in its own place. Look under the parcel record for the international journey. Keep the domestic references attached to the purchases they originally described. If another piece turns up or a seller answers a question much later, you can add that evidence without confusing it with a different shipment heading to your home. If the final warehouse count differs from the seller invoice, keep the count discrepancy open even after matching the waybill. Finding the carton and confirming its contents are separate outcomes.
corrections.translation: 后续提交国际配送时，另存出库包裹号，通过该包裹的记录查国际行程。原国内快递编号仍保留在各自购买记录下。这样，即使卖家很晚才答复，或之后才找到某个部件，也不会把这些进展误记到寄往家里的国际包裹上。运单已匹配但实收件数与卖家发票仍不符时，数量差异要继续查。找到外箱与确认箱内物品是两个结果。

corrections.source: You have a forwarding request, your seller says the package arrived and My Warehouse does not show the expected item. The most useful first step is to build a short investigation with one clearly defined missing link. Establish what the seller dispatched, where the carrier took it and what your Superbuy account shows. Each party can then check the part of the journey it actually handled.
corrections.translation: 你有一份转运申请，卖家说已经送到，My Warehouse 却没有预期的物品。先确定到底缺哪一环：卖家发了什么、承运商送去哪里、你的 Superbuy 账户当前显示什么。把问题缩小后，卖家、承运商和仓库都能核查各自经手的部分。

corrections.source: Write a sentence containing an observation and a question. “The domestic carrier records delivery of waybill X to the selected warehouse on Tuesday; I cannot match it to a stocked entry. Can you help identify it?” is specific. It does not require you to decide prematurely whether the merchant, carrier, warehouse or account entry is at fault.
corrections.translation: 用一句话说明观察到的事实和需要回答的问题。例如：“国内承运商记录显示，运单 X 周二已送到所选仓库，但我找不到相应的入库条目，可以帮忙核对吗？”这样对方知道要查什么，你也不必在证据不足时认定是卖家、承运商、仓库或账户登记出了错。

corrections.source: Avoid treating a missing entry as proof that the parcel was lost. The available evidence might instead describe an unused label, a delivery to a different warehouse, an unrecognized sender, an incomplete account identifier or a product recorded under an unexpected name. List only possibilities supported by something in your own records. If the seller has never supplied a collected waybill, the first unresolved step is dispatch, not warehouse intake.
corrections.translation: 找不到条目不等于包裹丢失。可能是面单还没有使用、送到了不同仓库、寄件人无法识别、账户识别信息不完整，也可能只是商品以意想不到的名称入库。只列出自己的记录确实支持的可能性。卖家连已揽收的运单都没提供时，首先要确认是否真的发货。

corrections.source: Create one row per event with the time, source and exact reference. Useful events include the marketplace purchase, forwarding request, review response, seller dispatch notice, carrier collection, last carrier scan and any warehouse message. Preserve the timezone shown by each source when it matters. Two events labelled “Tuesday” can occur on different local dates in the buyer's country and at the warehouse.
corrections.translation: 每次事件列一行，填上时间、来源和准确编号。可纳入下单、转运申请、审核答复、卖家发货通知、承运商揽收、最新物流扫描和仓库消息。必要时保留各来源的时区。同样写着“周二”，买家所在地与仓库所在地可能不是同一个当地日期。

corrections.source: Order the events by what occurred rather than the sequence in which notifications appeared on your phone. A delayed email can arrive after a newer carrier update. An order page may show an edited tracking number beneath an older dispatch date. If a time is unknown, leave it unknown. A timeline built from explicit events is more valuable than a polished story that invents the missing transition.
corrections.translation: 按事情实际发生的时间排序，不按手机通知弹出的顺序。较早的邮件可能晚于新物流通知才到；订单页可能在原发货日期下显示经过修改的新单号。无法确定的时间就留空。记录证据明确的事件，比擅自补出中间过程更有用。

corrections.source: Open your own Superbuy forwarding instructions and compare them with the address on the seller's confirmed order. Match warehouse, region, street and the account-specific information used to identify incoming shipments. Superbuy's guide explains the purpose of the identification number appearing with a receiving address. A seller may have copied the street correctly while shortening the last field on the printed label.
corrections.translation: 打开自己账户中的 Superbuy 转运收货说明，与卖家已确认订单上的地址核对。确认仓库、地区、街道，以及帮助识别入库货物的账户专属信息。Superbuy 指南解释了收货地址所附识别号的用途。卖家可能正确填写街道，却在打印面单时截短了最后一个字段。

corrections.source: If you find a difference, capture both records privately and describe it precisely. “The seller receipt shows the correct street but is missing the final identifier” gives the receiving team a concrete search clue. Do not substitute the corrected address for the original evidence. Likewise, do not rely on a profile update to correct a package already in transit. Ask the seller or carrier what address appears on the actual shipment when the order receipt is inconclusive.
corrections.translation: 如果发现不同，私下保存两份原始记录，并精确说明。例如：“卖家订单街道正确，但缺少末尾识别码。”这样仓库就有了查询线索。不要拿改正后的地址覆盖原始凭据，也不要以为更新账户地址会自动更改在途面单。如果订单信息仍无法判断，向卖家或承运商确认实际贴在包裹上的地址。

corrections.source: Check that the number belongs to the courier that physically handled the parcel. Distinguish it from a seller order, forwarding application, marketplace consolidation number or an international tracking number from a previous shipment. Open the merchant's shipping record and compare the carrier and complete number with what you entered in Superbuy. Leading zeroes, letters and transposed digits can all affect a match.
corrections.translation: 核实这个号码确实属于实际运输的快递公司，别错用卖家订单号、转运申请号、平台集运号或上次国际运输的追踪号。打开卖家发货记录，把承运商和完整运单与 Superbuy 中填写的内容逐字符比较。开头的零、字母和位置颠倒的数字都可能导致匹配失败。

corrections.source: A merchant may issue a label and then reprint a replacement. Ask which number has an actual collection event. If the replacement is the one that moved, name the original as an unused or superseded reference in the inquiry. That tells support why two numbers appear in the paperwork. If neither number has a collection event, ask the seller for evidence of handover before asking the warehouse to search for a delivered box.
corrections.translation: 卖家可能先开一张面单，再重新打印替代面单。问清哪个号码有真实揽件扫描。实际走的是新单号，就在问询里注明原号未使用或已被替换，让客服明白为何材料里出现两组号码。两者都没有揽收记录时，先向卖家索取交运证据，再决定是否请仓库查找“已签收”的箱子。

corrections.source: If the last evidence is a marketplace status saying the seller prepared the order, the seller can clarify actual dispatch. If a carrier records an attempted delivery or an address problem, ask about the unresolved delivery event. If the carrier confirms delivery to the expected destination and the logistics details were recorded, use the Superbuy support route associated with the forwarding request. Each inquiry should ask for an action the recipient can perform.
corrections.translation: 最后的证据若只是卖家“已备货”，应问卖家是否已经交寄。承运商若记录派送失败或地址异常，应询问尚未解决的投递事件。若承运商已确认送到正确目的地，转运物流信息也已填写，可在该转运申请对应的 Superbuy 客服渠道发起核查。每次向对方提出其实际能够执行的检查。

corrections.source: For a warehouse inquiry, include the request reference, selected warehouse, domestic carrier and waybill, delivery event, expected contents and any existing warehouse record that could be related. Explain which account view you checked. Share full identifying details through the official private channel. Crop unrelated orders and payment information from supporting screenshots, while keeping the specific reference, date and event legible.
corrections.translation: 向仓库询问时，一并提供申请编号、所选仓库、国内承运商及运单、签收事件、预期物品，以及可能相关的现有仓库条目。说清自己查的是账户中的哪个页面。完整的身份识别信息只交给官方私密渠道；截图可裁掉无关订单和支付信息，但不要遮住本次编号、日期和事件。

corrections.source: A first message might read: “Please check whether the carton under this domestic waybill was matched to my forwarding request. The carrier shows delivery to the selected warehouse. I attach the seller dispatch confirmation and the delivery scan. The expected contents are one shelf pack; the frame from the same seller is already stocked under a separate entry.” Add the real references in the appropriate private fields.
corrections.translation: 第一条消息可以写：“请核查这张国内运单的纸箱是否关联到了我的转运申请。承运商显示已送达所选仓库，随附卖家发货确认和签收扫描。我在等的是一箱层板，同一卖家的框架已经单独入库。”把真实编号填在对应的私密字段中。

corrections.source: If the response confirms receipt but says the contents were different, the investigation has moved forward. Ask which item was recorded from that waybill and compare it with the seller's packing statement. If the warehouse needs a photo of the physical label, request it from the seller rather than repeatedly resending a screenshot of the product itself. Preserve the question and response together so the next step builds on what has already been established.
corrections.translation: 对方确认收箱却说内容不一样，说明核查已经推进了一步。接下来要问的是该运单下具体登记了什么，再与卖家的装箱说明比对。仓库如需要实物面单照片，就向卖家索取，不必反复转发商品截图。把问题和答复放在一起，方便下一步在已确认的事实基础上继续。

corrections.source: When an entry appears, compare its physical description and quantity with what was expected. An entry with the same translated product title may belong to an earlier order. Confirm the connection using the forwarding reference, carrier evidence or the warehouse's explicit identification. Record what resolved the discrepancy and retain any outstanding quality or quantity question separately.
corrections.translation: 新条目出现后，核对实物描述和数量，而非仅凭翻译过的标题判断。同名条目可能是上次买的。通过转运申请、承运商记录或仓库明确的识别结果确认匹配，记下究竟是哪条证据解决了问题；若质量或数量还有疑点，分开保留。

corrections.source: A delivery investigation can finish with a matched item, a correction to the sender's record, a carrier inquiry or another documented outcome. Record the actual outcome rather than forcing every case into “delivered.” If you subsequently send the goods overseas, create a new outbound parcel entry. The inbound investigation then remains a complete account of how the warehouse identified the package, ready to consult if the seller or carrier asks about it later.
corrections.translation: 调查可能以找到物品、寄件方更正记录、承运商继续调查或其他有凭据的结果结束。写下实际结果，不必把所有案例都填成“已送达”。日后再发海外时，另开一条出库包裹记录。本次调查就完整保留了仓库怎样认领和识别来件，卖家或快递以后再问仍查得到。

corrections.source: If you ultimately discover that the parcel was stocked under an unexpected description, note the phrase used by the warehouse and the evidence that established the match. It can be useful to record a picture reference and the original seller description next to that entry. The warehouse title may stay unchanged even after support confirms its identity. If it is later split across parcels, retain the original reference beside both outbound records so you can identify the right portion at delivery.
corrections.translation: 最后发现只是仓库品名出乎意料，就记下该品名和确认匹配的证据。可以将图片编号和卖家原始品名并列留存；即使客服确认身份，仓库标题也可能不改。如果之后拆成两票发，在两条出库记录旁都保留原始仓库编号，收货时才能确认各自对应的部分。

corrections.source: A mobile screen makes it easy to save a photograph and hard to see the complete purchase in one view. The image, selected variant, quantity and price can appear on separate panels. Superbuy's app guide describes finding a product, selecting its options and asking the agent to purchase it. Use those stages as checkpoints. The aim is to carry your intended selection all the way from the seller listing to the paid order.
corrections.translation: 手机上存图很方便，但常常无法在一屏里同时看到商品、所选款式、数量和价格。Superbuy 应用指南依次说明查找商品、选择选项、委托购买。把这些环节当作检查点，确保最初在卖家页面看中的组合一直保留到实际付款的订单。

corrections.source: Before switching apps, save the original marketplace product link. If a share sheet includes promotional text around the address, preserve the underlying listing address where possible. Make a short note of the seller and item identifier. That gives you a way back if opening a shopping link changes the active browser tab or if a marketplace app returns to its home screen.
corrections.translation: 切换应用前保存原商家的商品链接。分享面板若在地址前后附上推广文案，尽可能单独保留底层商品网址，并记下卖家和商品编号。这样即使点击购买链接后浏览器跳到另一标签页，或电商应用退回首页，也能回到刚才那件商品。

corrections.source: A screenshot is a useful companion, especially for a distinctive pattern. It rarely contains all the information required to identify a live listing. The same studio picture can appear on multiple products or be reused by different sellers. A saved image showing a blue notebook does not establish which shop offers it, what paper is inside or whether the photograph depicts the cover only. Save the link first and the picture second.
corrections.translation: 遇到特别的图案时，截图很有帮助，但一张图通常不足以识别当前有效的商品页。同一张棚拍图可能用于多个商品，也可能被不同卖家使用。例如，一张蓝色纸质笔记本的图片无法说明是哪家店、用什么内页，甚至无法确认照片卖的是整本还是只有封套。先留链接，再留图片。

corrections.source: Avoid using a note to contradict a selected option without checking whether the seller can supply the request. Selecting the cheaper cover and writing “complete book please” does not establish that the full set has been purchased. If a required combination is absent from the live selector, ask whether it is available and what it costs. Save the response with the order confirmation.
corrections.translation: 选项与备注矛盾时，先确认卖家能否满足要求。选中便宜的封套，再写“请发整本”，不能证明自己已买到完整套装。要的组合在当前选项里不存在，就问清能否提供、价格是多少，把答复和订单确认放在一起。

corrections.source: Once payment is complete, save the Superbuy order reference. Use the order inquiry or other contact route shown for questions about that purchase. A question about an unavailable colour belongs with the shopping record; a shipping quote for an assembled outbound parcel belongs later in the process. Naming the stage helps the person responding understand what action you expect.
corrections.translation: 付款后，保存 Superbuy 的代购订单编号。对这次购买有疑问，使用订单内的咨询或联系入口。颜色缺货要查代购单；合包后的运费则属以后的出库阶段。说明自己正处在哪一环，对方才知道你希望其采取什么行动。

corrections.source: When the item is stocked, the official guide points you to My Warehouse. Reopen your note alongside the warehouse pictures. Check what is visible: a closed black cover might match the colour but not the page ruling. If the interior matters, request a view that shows the relevant feature and check the available inspection options for that item. Keep the item reference in the request so a photo of a similar notebook cannot be accidentally used to make your decision.
corrections.translation: 入库后按官方指南去 My Warehouse，将购买备注和仓库照片放在一起核对。闭合的黑色封面只能核对颜色，看不出内页是横线还是点阵。如果内页关系到判断，就先问该物品提供哪些检查，再请求能看清相应细节的照片。注明仓库编号，免得把另一本文具的照片当成这本。

corrections.source: If the app closes during checkout or payment, inspect the order and payment records before repeating the action. A checkout screen reopening at its beginning does not establish whether the payment succeeded. Look for the order reference, the amount, currency and latest payment state. If they disagree, use the official support channel with those details. Avoid creating a second order merely to see whether the first one existed.
corrections.translation: 结账或付款时应用关闭，先查订单和支付记录，再决定是否重试。结账页面重新从头打开，并不说明付款成功或失败。找订单编号、金额、币种和最新支付状态。若记录不符，带着这些细节联系官方客服，不要为“验证第一单是否存在”再下一单。

corrections.source: Finish by keeping a compact mobile record: seller link, complete option, unit and quantity, paid order reference and the feature that must be checked at intake. Once you have those fields, changing devices or reopening a cart becomes manageable. You can explain exactly what you commissioned, recognize your own warehouse item and handle freight as a new decision when the item is ready. That continuity is more valuable than any particular arrangement of buttons in an app update.
corrections.translation: 手机上保留一条简明记录：卖家链接、完整选项、购买单位和数量、已付款订单编号，以及入库时必须核实的特征。换设备或重新打开购物车都能依靠这些信息回到正确的商品。能讲清委托了什么、认出哪件是自己的货，再单独决定如何发运，比记住某个版本应用里的按钮位置更重要。

corrections.source: For purchases made for someone else, send the final selected option back to that person before checkout if the choice was ambiguous. Ask them to confirm the exact attribute at issue, such as ruling, sleeve length or included accessory. A reply approving a clear written specification is easier to use later than a thumbs-up attached to a general product photo. Save the final confirmation alongside the original order record.
corrections.translation: 替别人购买时，如果某项要求含糊，结账前把最终选择发回给收件人，明确请对方确认内页格式、袖长或所含配件等具体特征。一句针对明确规格的确认，比在笼统商品图下点个赞更方便以后复核。把最终答复与原订单放在一起。

corrections.source: A warehouse list starts as a set of arrivals, then gradually becomes a set of decisions. One jacket is ready, another needs a measurement, a gift must keep its box and a replacement has arrived for an older order. Selecting every visible entry can mix those decisions together. Organize the entries around what you can actually dispatch.
corrections.translation: 入库清单最初记的是哪些货到了，随后要管理的是每件货能不能发。一件夹克已可发，另一件还要量尺寸，礼品要留盒，旧订单的替换件刚到。若直接全选，就会把这些不同决定混在一起。按哪些条目实际具备发货条件来整理。

corrections.source: Start a row for each relevant warehouse entry. Copy the reference as displayed, the associated purchase or forwarding record and a description you can recognize later. A translated product name can be ambiguous. A reference combined with a precise description, such as “navy medium, plain cuffs,” helps you distinguish a unit from a similar item bought several days earlier.
corrections.translation: 为每个相关仓库条目单独建一行，抄下原样显示的编号、关联的代购单或转运申请，并写一段自己以后认得出的说明。翻译品名可能含糊，“深蓝 M 码、素色袖口”配上仓库编号，才能和几天前买的相似商品区分。

corrections.source: Do not make the seller order the sole key in your record. A seller order can produce several warehouse entries. A forwarding parcel can contain goods from more than one purchase. A replacement may resemble the original so closely that both titles appear identical. Keep a separate field for the event linking the entries, such as “replacement for original entry” or “second unit from same order,” instead of renaming both goods as though they were one.
corrections.translation: 别把卖家订单号当成唯一识别键。一份卖家订单可能分成多个库存条目，一只转运包裹也可能装着不同购买记录的商品。替换件与原件甚至标题完全一样。另开字段写清“原条目的替换件”“同一订单的第二件”等关联关系，不要把两件货改名成同一件。

corrections.source: Give each entry a practical state. Useful examples include ready to ship, awaiting a measurement, awaiting seller information, return under discussion and deliberately held for another item. These are your private working notes; use the actual platform status separately. The point is to record what you personally need before allowing that item into an outbound parcel.
corrections.translation: 为每条记录设一个能指导操作的状态，如可发、待测量、等卖家答复、正在讨论退货、为等另一件货主动暂存。这里记的是你自己的安排；平台显示的状态要另存。这样能看出在允许某件货进国际包裹前，你还需要做什么。

corrections.source: For every open question, name who can answer it. The retailer may know whether an accessory belongs to a particular bundle. Warehouse staff may be able to show whether that accessory is physically present. You can decide whether a small cosmetic mark is acceptable. If a row merely says “check,” nobody knows whose action will close it. Replace that word with “waiting for a photograph of the inside label” or “compare width with my own jacket.”
corrections.translation: 每个待办问题都写明由谁回答。某个套装包不包含配件，卖家可能说得准；箱内实物有没有该配件，仓库可以拍照；轻微外观痕迹能否接受，则由自己判断。与其只写“查一下”，不如写“等内标照片”或“与自家夹克的胸宽比较”。

corrections.source: Use possible groups for planning. One group might contain ordinary clothing ready now; another might contain the fragile item whose packing is under discussion. Record which items and packing assumptions went into each estimate. If a route disappears after you add a particular entry, investigate that change before comparing freight totals. Adding a new item does not guarantee that the original route and service conditions survive unchanged.
corrections.translation: 可以先建几组寄送方案。例如，一组全是已准备好的普通衣物，一组包含还在讨论包装的易碎品。每次估价列出具体物品和包装假设。加入某件物品后线路消失，要先查可用条件发生了什么变化，再比较运费；新组合未必继续享有原线路和服务条件。

corrections.source: Check the current storage information for each entry in your account. Arrival, intake and the deadline displayed for that specific entry are more useful to you than the date you first found the product online. An older item can be approaching a decision point while a newly stocked item from the same seller has more time available. A single date attached to the planned parcel hides that difference.
corrections.translation: 每件货都查自己账户当前显示的保管信息。到仓日、入库日和该条目具体的截止日，比你第一次在网上看到商品的日子更有意义。同一卖家的旧货可能快要决定去留，新入库的货却尚有时间。只给计划中的整包填一个日期会掩盖这种区别。

corrections.source: If a seller issue is still open, record its own action deadline independently. A storage allowance and a seller return opportunity answer different questions. Waiting for one more order to consolidate freight can be reasonable for a confirmed item and unwise for an item with an unresolved defect. Read the conditions applicable to your purchase before letting a planned shipping date control an unrelated return decision.
corrections.translation: 卖家问题还没处理完，就另记处理期限。仓储期限与卖方退货窗口回答的是两件事。已确认的货为了省运费等合包可能合理；有未解决缺陷的货同样等待，可能错过退货机会。先看这次购买适用的条件，别让原定发货日替你决定一项无关的售后问题。

corrections.source: Use a consistent sequence for similar units. Compare the first order note, the corresponding warehouse reference and its photos together. Finish that match before opening the next nearly identical item. If a photo lacks a useful feature, write down exactly what evidence is missing. Two garments with the same front graphic may need different label views to establish which belongs to each recipient.
corrections.translation: 同款物品按固定顺序核对。把第一笔订单备注、相应仓库编号和照片放在一起确认，再打开下一个几乎一样的条目。照片欠缺关键特征，就具体注明缺什么。同样的正面印花并不能证明两件衣服属于同一位收件人，有时需要分别拍各自的标签。

corrections.source: A practical example is two dark sweatshirts ordered in medium and large. One warehouse picture may show a marked large label while the other shows only a folded front. Do not label the folded one medium solely by elimination if the other order is still in transit or could have been mispacked. Ask for the identifying view tied to the ambiguous entry. Once confirmed, record which unit has which label and the date of that check.
corrections.translation: 例如两件深色卫衣分别订了 M 和 L。一张仓库照片能读到 L，另一张只拍折好的正面。如果另一单仍在路上，或卖家可能装错箱，就不能仅靠排除法认定折着的那件一定是 M。按不明确的仓库编号请求一张能辨认的照片，确认后记录标签和核对日期。

corrections.source: Before submission, transfer only the instructions that apply to the chosen parcel. A note to retain a collector's sleeve belongs with the specific book. Reinforcement of an outer carton concerns the entire parcel. Describe the object and action together so that one instruction does not inadvertently override another, particularly when removing some packaging while keeping other pieces intact.
corrections.translation: 提交前，只把适用于这票货的备注转成包装指令。珍藏版要保留的书套对应的是特定那本书，外箱加固则针对整箱。把动作和对象写在一起，特别是在拆除部分包装、保留其余包装时，避免一项指令抵消另一项。

corrections.source: When you submit goods for delivery from My Warehouse, compare the selected entries with your ready list one final time. Check reference, option, count and packing instructions. Save the outbound reference when issued and attach it to the selected entries. Leave the unselected items showing their own states; moving three items into a parcel does not resolve a fourth item's outstanding measurement request.
corrections.translation: 从 My Warehouse 提交发货时，对照可发清单再检查一遍实际选中的编号、款式、数量和包装要求。出库包裹号产生后，将它记到所选物品旁。没有选中的仍保留原状态；三件已组包，不代表第四件待测量的问题也解决了。

corrections.source: After dispatch, use the outbound parcel record for international tracking. Keep the original warehouse links until delivery is complete. If a parcel arrives with three items when you expected four, your record should immediately tell you whether a fourth item was actually selected or deliberately held. That single distinction can save a lengthy search through seller histories, carrier scans and nearly identical photos.
corrections.translation: 发货后用出库包裹记录追踪国际行程，保留原始入库关联直到签收。如果以为应该有四件，却只收了三件，清单应该能立刻回答第四件是否真的选进包裹，还是故意留仓。先分清这两种情况，比事后翻找卖家记录、物流扫描和相似照片省力得多。

corrections.source: A good warehouse list is short enough to maintain and specific enough to answer the next decision. If a row contains a reference, physical identity, readiness, open question and eventual parcel, it can follow an item from intake to dispatch without losing the details that made you choose it.
corrections.translation: 好用的库存清单应够短，方便日常维护，但又够具体，能支持下一步决定。每行有仓库编号、实物身份、可发状态、未决问题及最终所属包裹，便可从入库追到出库，同时不丢失最初选择这件商品的重要细节。

corrections.source: For gifts going to different recipients, add the destination group to each entry before comparing combined parcels. A single low freight quote to your address says nothing about the cost of redistributing the contents afterwards. Grouping by intended recipient first can expose a shipping choice that a simple total of warehouse weights conceals.
corrections.translation: 送给不同人的礼物，在比较合包方案前先给每件标上收件分组。寄到自己地址的单票低运费，并不反映随后分寄给不同收件人的费用。先按最终收件人分组，能发现只把库存重量相加时看不到的选择。

corrections.source: The official app guide describes searching from the home screen and recognizing certain product links. Use the available entry method on your device. When the agent page opens, compare its product and seller information with what you intended to import. Do not infer a match merely because the first image looks familiar.
corrections.translation: 官方应用指南介绍了从首页搜索商品和识别部分商品链接的方法。按自己设备上提供的入口操作。跳到代购页面后，对照原商品核实商品和卖家信息，别只因为首图眼熟就认定导入成功。

corrections.source: If the device opens a search result list rather than the exact product, treat this as a new identification step. Compare the original item number where available, then examine the option set and seller details. A search result with another seller and a lower displayed price is a separate purchasing choice. If you still want it, review it as a new listing rather than silently replacing the earlier selection in your notes.
corrections.translation: 如果打开的是搜索结果列表，而非准确的商品页，就当作重新找商品。先核对原商品编号，再看可选规格及店铺信息。不同卖家的低价结果属于另一项购买选择。如果仍考虑买，就重新审核这个商品，别在记录中悄悄把原来的选择替换掉。

corrections.source: Open the selector and identify the dimensions of the choice. A product can have colour, size, bundle contents and quantity, each controlled separately. Some combinations may be unavailable even if the colour swatch itself appears selectable. Make the complete selection, then look for the final summary. Scroll horizontally or expand text where the interface abbreviates a long option label.
corrections.translation: 打开选项面板，确认要选的是哪些字段。颜色、尺码、套装内容和数量可能分别控制；色块可点也不代表所有组合有货。完成整个组合后，再看最后的选择摘要。长标签被截断时，横向滑动或展开文字，读到完整规格。

corrections.source: A quantity selector counts the unit represented by the chosen option. If the option says a pack of three, setting the quantity to two can mean six physical pieces. If the price refers to a replacement cover, it may omit the book displayed in a lifestyle photograph. Read the unit description and the subtotal after making the selection.
corrections.translation: 数量框计算的是所选规格所对应的销售单位。如果一组是三件，数量选二可能代表六个实物。若价格对应替换封套，场景图里那本书可能并不包含在内。确定选项后再读单位说明和商品小计。

corrections.source: An illustrative check is to write “two packs, three pieces per pack, six pieces expected” before checkout. Compare that reading with the displayed quantity and the merchant's option description. If one screen describes two units and another describes six pieces, they may be consistent. If you cannot explain the difference yourself, ask the agent to clarify before authorizing a purchase. Do not try to fix an unknown unit by choosing a larger number and hoping the seller interprets it correctly.
corrections.translation: 付款前可写下“两组，每组三件，预计六个实物”，再比对页面数量和卖家的规格说明。一页写“两组”，另一页写“六件”，可能完全一致。若自己也讲不清差异，先请代购确认，再授权购买；不要靠调大数量，指望卖家猜到你的意思。

corrections.source: After adding the item, reopen its cart line. Check the exact option, quantity, seller and current price. A previously saved cart item can survive between sessions and look like a second copy of today's item. Compare dates or line details before changing quantities. Replacing an old option with a new line can leave both selected for payment.
corrections.translation: 加入购物车后，重新打开该行，检查确切规格、数量、卖家和现价。旧购物车项目可能跨会话保留，看起来像是今天重复加了商品。改数量前先查日期或行内详情；用新行替换旧选项时，也可能两行都还勾选着付款。

corrections.source: Read each charge in context. Superbuy's shopping guide separates the purchase and any applicable domestic delivery from the later international parcel process. Save the currency and total on the purchase screen. If a catalogue converts a price for convenience, use that figure for rough comparison and use the actual checkout amount for your payment record. A mobile notification quoting a card amount may use a different currency and cannot by itself identify the selected item.
corrections.translation: 按交易环节读取每项费用。Superbuy 购物指南将商品购买、可能适用的国内配送，与后续国际包裹分开。检查当前所选规格的商品价和首笔付款涵盖的项目。目录换算出来的展示价可能用的是另一种货币，单靠价格也不能识别具体选了哪一款。

corrections.source: A single purchase can generate two exceptions that look like opposites. One warehouse entry looks incomplete because a second box is still travelling. A second entry looks like a duplicate because the product name matches the first. Both can describe a correctly split purchase. To work out what arrived, count purchases, cartons and individual pieces separately.
corrections.translation: 一笔购买可能出现两种表面相反的异常：第二箱仍在路上，第一条入库记录像是少了货；第二条记录又因品名与第一条相同，看起来像重复。两种现象都可能来自正常分箱。要弄清究竟收到了什么，应分开统计购买单位、纸箱数和实物件数。

corrections.source: Start with the paid option rather than the lead photograph. A listing showing a desk and chair might sell a desk only, a chair only or a package containing both. The unit on the receipt determines what you should expect to account for. Write it in plain language. If the seller calls a set “one unit,” list the pieces you expect inside it without turning those pieces into additional purchased units.
corrections.translation: 从已付款的规格入手，而不是从首图猜。展示书桌和椅子的页面可能只卖桌、只卖椅子，也可能两件合售。收据上的单位决定了应收到什么。用自己的话抄明白：卖家把“一套”当作一个购买单位时，列出套内应有的各部件，但不要又把它们当成额外买了几件。

corrections.source: Suppose you ordered two identical table lamps. The merchant confirms that each lamp comprises a base, shade and fittings packet. Your purchase record therefore describes two units and six expected components. It still tells you nothing about how many boxes the merchant will use. The seller might send each complete lamp separately, group the bases together or place both sets in one outer carton. You need a packing statement to connect those counts.
corrections.translation: 例如买了两盏相同台灯，卖家确认每盏由一个底座、一个灯罩和一包配件组成。购买记录因此是两套、预计六个部件，却还不能推出包裹数。卖家可能每盏一箱、把两个底座同箱，或者全部合装。要把购买数和箱数对上，还需要装箱说明。

corrections.source: Ask the seller how many parcels were actually handed over and which carrier number belongs to each. If the merchant supplied a packing list, copy its wording. When contents by box are unknown, say so in your notes. An honest blank tells you what remains to be established. A guessed assignment may silently convert a normal arrival into a false missing-item report.
corrections.translation: 向卖家问清实际交寄几箱，每箱对应哪个承运商单号。已有装箱清单就尽量保留原文；不知道具体搭配，就在记录里留空。留白提醒你还要查什么，猜测某件在哪一箱，却可能把一次正常到货误报成缺件。

corrections.source: Give boxes short names in your own notes while keeping the complete carrier number. For the lamps, “box ending 482, expected both bases” is more useful than “large box.” A repacked carton can look different from the seller's photograph, and dimensions can be reported in different orientations. If the waybills came from different carriers, include each carrier's name. Two similar strings can have different meanings in different tracking systems.
corrections.translation: 在自己的记录中给每个箱子取短名，但同时保留完整运单号。以台灯为例，“尾号 482、预计两个底座”比“大箱子”更容易识别。重新包装后外观可能和卖家照片不同，尺寸也可能按不同朝向填写。不同承运商的编号外观可能相似，应把公司名一起记下。

corrections.source: Read the status for every waybill independently. If two boxes left together, they can still receive scans at different times. A single order-level status on a marketplace may summarize part of the purchase. Open the underlying delivery details and note the latest event for each actual box. Keep a cancelled label separate from a waybill associated with a collected parcel.
corrections.translation: 就算两个箱子一同交寄，物流扫描也可能先后出现。电商页面上的单一订单状态有时只概括了部分商品。打开具体配送详情，按实箱记下各自的最新事件。取消的面单另外标明，不要与已揽收箱子的有效单号混在一起。

corrections.source: In the lamp example, the box expected to hold the two bases has a delivery scan, while the box containing shades and fittings is still in transit. A warehouse record with two bases is consistent with those facts. Mark the bases as accounted for and the other four components as pending. Do not report two missing lamps simply because the original order quantity was two. The meaningful outstanding question is whether the second carton has been delivered and identified.
corrections.translation: 在台灯例子中，装两个底座的箱子显示已送达，灯罩和配件所在的箱子仍在途中。仓库登记了两个底座，正与现有证据相符。把底座记为已核对，其余四个部件暂记待到。别因订单写“两盏”就报告两盏灯全缺；此时要查的是第二箱是否已送达并被识别。

corrections.source: Once goods are stocked, Superbuy's guides direct users to My Warehouse. Inspect item names and photographs alongside your box map. Decide what each picture actually shows. A closed retail carton labelled “shade set” can support identification of a carton without establishing the count or condition of its contents. A visible pair of shades does not establish that both fittings packets are present.
corrections.translation: 入库后，按 Superbuy 指南去 My Warehouse。把条目名称和照片放在分箱表旁，判断照片实际能证明什么。闭合的包装盒印着“灯罩套装”，可以帮助辨认箱子，却不能确认里面的数量和完好程度。即使照片里看得见两个灯罩，也不等于两包配件已经齐全。

corrections.source: A merchant may send a small accessory separately without updating the initial packing summary. If a later tracking notice arrives, do not alter the older record to make it appear that you always expected three boxes. Add a dated update naming the source of the new information. Identify which component moved from a previous expectation into the additional carton.
corrections.translation: 卖家可能把小配件另寄，原装箱说明却还没更新。后来收到新的物流通知，不要回头把旧记录改成“早就知道有三箱”。另加一条带日期的更新，写清新消息来自谁、哪件原以为在之前箱里的物品改放到额外纸箱。

corrections.source: Suppose the merchant reports that the fittings packets were sent by a different carrier. The original second carton is now expected to contain shades only. If the warehouse confirms two shades, that carton can be marked complete even though the overall purchase is still incomplete. Record the third waybill and its expected two fittings packets. This simple distinction matters if the first two cartons are ready to dispatch and the third is delayed.
corrections.translation: 假设卖家补充说明：两包配件交给了另一家承运商，原来的第二箱实际只有灯罩。那么仓库确认两个灯罩后，第二箱就可记为齐全，整笔购买仍可保持未齐。再登记第三张运单和预期的两包配件。前两箱可以发、第三箱延误时，这种区分尤其有用。

corrections.source: Check the applicable storage position and live parcel options for the actual entries. Compare like assumptions. A partial shipment today and a later shipment of accessories may incur two separate outbound charges. A combined parcel later may have different dimensions, packaging needs and route eligibility. Treat each price as a quote for a named set of contents. Nothing about a domestic seller's choice of box count guarantees which outbound packing arrangement will suit you.
corrections.translation: 查各条目的实际仓储情况，以及当前可选的包裹方案。今天发一部分、配件以后再寄，可能产生两票出库运费；等齐再发，又涉及不同的箱体尺寸、保护需要和线路资格。给每份报价写清对应哪些物品。卖家在国内用了几个箱子，并不能决定你国际发货时怎样打包最合适。

corrections.source: If the carrier shows all boxes delivered but the account reflects only some of the contents, build a compact exception report. State the merchant order, each carrier and waybill, the expected contents of each carton, and the warehouse entries found. Then name the single unmatched box or missing component. Distinguish the seller's statement from the warehouse photo; being clear about the evidence makes it easier to decide whether the next check belongs with the seller or the receiving team.
corrections.translation: 将异常报告写具体：卖家订单、每箱的承运商与运单、每箱本应装的东西，以及已找到的仓库条目。最后只点名尚未匹配的那个箱子或部件。区分“卖家说装了什么”和“仓库照片显示什么”，才容易判断下一步该请卖家核对还是请仓库检查。

corrections.source: Avoid sending ten loosely related screenshots. Select the order confirmation establishing quantity, the dispatch statement establishing box allocation, the specific carrier event and a warehouse image showing the discrepancy. If a screenshot covers other orders or personal information, limit what you share to what the official support channel needs. Retain the originals privately in case a clearer view is requested.
corrections.translation: 不必一股脑发十张关系松散的截图。选能确认购买数量的订单、说明分箱的发货记录、相关的物流事件和呈现差异的仓库照片。截图如包含无关订单或个人信息，只向官方渠道提供这次调查所需部分；自己保留完整原件，以便对方要求更清晰的视图。

corrections.source: When all expected pieces are accounted for, write a closure note naming the contents accepted. For the lamps it might read, “Two bases, two shades and two fittings packets checked against the seller confirmation; warehouse entries A, B and C belong to this purchase.” Keep any visible defect or disputed measurement as its own open issue until resolved. A complete component count alone does not settle condition.
corrections.translation: 所有预期部件都对上后，写一句具体结论，如“两只底座、两只灯罩和两包配件均与卖家确认清单一致；仓库条目 A、B、C 都属于这次购买”。外观缺陷或有争议的测量值另设待办。件数齐全，只能确认数量，不能同时证明状态完好。

corrections.source: If you later combine these goods into one international parcel, attach the outbound reference to that group of warehouse entries. When the shipment reaches you, unpack against the component list rather than trying to remember the merchant's domestic carton arrangement. The seller might have sent three boxes and the international packer might use one. Your original list of required pieces remains useful through either packing choice, and it gives you a precise starting point if something is absent at delivery.
corrections.translation: 之后合成国际包裹时，把新出库编号关联到这组仓库条目。签收开箱时对着部件清单点数，不必记住卖家国内如何装箱。卖家原来分三箱，国际发运可能只用一箱；不管采用哪个方案，应有的部件清单始终有效。缺了东西时，也能马上说清缺的是哪件。

corrections.source: Check loose hardware against the assembly instructions when those instructions are available. A photograph of several small metal pieces rarely establishes which fasteners belong to which unit. Ask the merchant for the expected count by type and keep that statement with the parts list rather than relying on the total weight of the hardware bag.
corrections.translation: 有装配说明时，用它核对散装五金。一张小金属零件合照很难证明每种紧固件分别属于哪一套。请卖家提供各类型应有的数量，与零件清单一起保留，别用整袋总重量代替按类型清点。

corrections.source: The easiest time to connect a self-purchased item with its warehouse record is before the seller prints a label. You can still change an address, ask what the box will contain and correct a description without having to trace a parcel in transit. Use Superbuy's forwarding guide alongside the instructions in your own account. The sequence matters more than the position of any individual button.
corrections.translation: 最容易把自购物件和未来仓库条目对应起来的时机，是卖家打印面单之前。此时还能改地址、问清箱内物品、修正描述，不必再追踪已在路上的包裹。请结合 Superbuy 的转运指南和自己账户中的收货说明操作；先后顺序比某个按钮在屏幕的什么位置更重要。

corrections.source: Open the original purchase confirmation. Write down the merchant, product name, chosen option, number of units and item type. Use words that distinguish the actual thing inside the box. “Case” could describe a suitcase, a phone cover or a protective box for a camera. “Fabric camera pouch, small, empty” communicates more to someone reviewing what is being sent.
